card.title: How To Repair Nintendo Switch WiFi Not Working

source.title: How To Repair Nintendo Switch WiFi Not Working

claims.statement: Switch Lite Wi-Fi failure (2110-1118, missing toggle) is commonly a failed Broadcom Wi-Fi IC or resistors beside the USB-C port that were dislodged during earlier work.
A replacement Wi-Fi IC must be an original pulled from a donor Switch Lite.
Four tiny resistors near the USB-C port are often lost when desoldering the port; replace with values from a donor.

procedure: Inspect resistors near USB-C and the Wi-Fi IC.
Replace missing resistors, or swap in a donor Switch Lite Wi-Fi IC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
